sections_en.text:
This document 
sets out 
the five-yearly inspection steps for 
CO2 fire extinguishers; 
these extinguishers are used for firefighting in enclosed places by expelling oxygen.

The first draft was prepared 
and tested 
by Eng. Hosni Hassan Hussein; 
reviewed by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Taha Khater; and approved by Eng. 
Hamdi Abdel Mawla Meleigy:
General Manager of the El Shabab Gas Power Station

Mr. Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Director of Inspection and Quality Control at the East Delta Electricity Production Company and the Company's MPIS Coordinator, approved this document, and it was attested by Mr. Mahmoud Suleiman, Accountant, General Director of Financial and Administrative Control and Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the East Delta Electricity Production Company

rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card

Cordon off 
the area to define the work area, and place warning signs

Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment 
 (safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, overalls, 
 gloves, etc.)
Occupational safety and health equipment such as a safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, etc.

Tool bag consisting of a set of spanners (open-end 
, 
 ring) and assorted screwdrivers.

Body test unit 
, 
 dryer

Collect
 the cylinders at the extinguisher body test unit

Fill
 the cylinders with water using the water pump of the 
 unit

Move
 the test valve to the 
Test
 position and open the test water source and the main air source.

Operate 
 the body test unit to start the test for 5 units in one batch up to a pressure of 
 250 
 bar

Leave 
 the cylinder under this pressure for 5 minutes; after the test succeeds, release the pressure 
 by moving the test valve to the 
 Release position

Remove the carbon dioxide cylinders, 
 empty them
 of water and dry them
 thoroughly with a special dryer

Refill 
 the powder cylinders with new powder and check that 
 their pressure is now correct
Lead-seal the valves of the cylinders

Inspect 
 the extinguisher hoses and check that there are no cracks in them
Check that the hose nozzle is clean
Check that the hose coupling is firmly fixed

Check that the extinguisher chassis 
, 
 the wheels of the unit are sound

The extinguisher is 
 scraped
 and painted when necessary.

Check that the fire extinguisher 
is clean

Affix 
 the sticker 
 showing the test date
